mode: self-hosted server, MCP over Streamable HTTP, auth off on loopback
door: search(query, viewer="agent:<id>", limit=10, verbose=true) over MCP
results: limit 10 (adapter's choice; Aionforge's default not stated), min_relevance 0 (deployment default, no floor), no cut
model: none (consolidation derives facts and entities without a model)
embeddings: gemini-embedding-001, 3072 dimensions, Google through its OpenAI-compatible endpoint, behind a loopback shim
storage: a Docker volume (store engine not stated)
not_default: forgetting enabled with its floors lowered (off by default; the benchmark must remove what it writes); embeddings gemini-embedding-001 behind a shim that adds the `index` field Google omits (the maintainer runs gemini-embedding-2 on OpenRouter)
